title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Market Pulse. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Market Pulse
options.thesis: The IPO journey as a live, high-velocity broadcast ticker.
options.viewport: Ticker at top, IPO cards styled as data-blocks, allotment CTA.
options.risk: Reads as a generic dashboard when motion is subtle.

options.label: IPO Journey
options.thesis: The IPO journey as an airport itinerary: event-driven, sequence-focused.
options.viewport: Gate board list, top boarding pass for allotment.
options.case: High scannability, familiar metaphor, clear hierarchy.
options.risk: Reads like a shipping app if type is not authoritative.

options.label: Dalal Heritage
options.thesis: Financial truth as marked on the physical marketplace chalkboard.
options.viewport: Dark slate surfaces, white chalk typography, bold yellow accents.
options.risk: Familiarity is very high; feels grounded but less innovative.
